coverage.testing_start: After first full fiscal month following commitment termination, per section 6.12
coverage.definition: Contractually defined net operating income divided by defined debt service over trailing three fiscal months; not a group GAAP ratio.
coverage.debt_service_excludes: Final maturity bullet and specified other repayments excluded by contract definition
coverage.cure: Section7.03 allows defined equity cures: financial covenant deadline is the fifteenth day after required statement delivery date; a cash-shortfall cure has a different thirty-day window. Lenders need not advance during the breach. Usage limit changes after a defined sunset date; no borrower compliance certificate inspected.
coverage.locator: Definitions Debt Service/DSCR/Projected DSCR; sections 6.12 and 7.03

hypothetical.meaning: Arithmetic illustration only, not actual covenant inputs, estimated headroom or a default forecast.

rating_scope.maintenance_clause: Section5.18 requires a rating to be maintained, not a specified rating level.

recovery.reason: No complete perfection/search record, executed collateral schedules, realizable GPU prices or correlated customer-default scenario verified. First-priority claim is a legal position, not a recovery percentage.

Complete collateral agreement and perfection filings
Borrower-specific compliance certificates and actual ratios
Cash reserves and contingent draw headroom today
Customer payment waterfall cash actually received
GPU liquidation values, re-letting expense and correlated customer default
Existing principal schedule, not all future cash uses, interest, leases or undrawn commitments.
Final legal maturity does not mean all principal waits until that date.
A later equity settlement is reported for the April convertible promissory notes; do not label all scheduled principal a cash repayment.
Current portion covers a different time window from the remaining nine months of calendar 2026; carrying amount and principal also differ.
June and August originals were discovered but not fully retrievable; no current-amount claim is admitted from search extracts.
DDTL4 timing uses management estimates of specified start events; not all dates are an independently reconstructed fixed repayment schedule.
The same Q1 filing reports April revolver repayment and new note issuance. Neither this ladder nor selected subsequent events reconstruct September debt.
May and June event evidence narrows the later-source gap but does not substitute for the unread June-quarter or August original documents.
